text_block_list.text:
On this day, I came to the zoo with Hokko 
Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... Actually, it's about 
yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, you're going to the zoo tomorrow? In 
that case, let's check your directional 
fortune!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Here we go again. It's not like I'm going 
there looking for good luck or anything...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You did it, Tarumae! A totally 
auspicious direction, without a doubt!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It looks like the absolute best 
destination. Our luck might improve and 
bring good fortune our way!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... There you go again with those 
unscientific things...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
And that's how it was, which is why I 
ended up on guard...
choice_data_list:
If it's a good thing, why not just believe 
it?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'll think about that once we see the 
results.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Come now, let's just enjoy ourselves. It 
is our day off, after all!

And so, I walked around the zoo with Hokko 
Tarumae, but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Seeing animals up close really hits 
different. I enjoyed myself completely.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, nothing particularly good ended 
up happening. I'll have to report back to 
Rickey..."

text_block_list.name: Zoo Staff
text_block_list.text: Um... Aren't you Hokko Tarumae-san?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, yes! That's right, but...!

text_block_list.name: Zoo Staff
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! I saw your event in front of 
the station before!

text_block_list.name: Zoo Staff
text_block_list.text:
You were singing wild bird songs back 
then, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I sang! Tomakomai has the best spot for 
birdwatching!

text_block_list.name: Zoo Staff
text_block_list.text:
I knew it...! Um, the truth is, we're 
opening a wild bird viewing spot in the 
park, and we were looking for a guest!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I-If that's the case! Please let me 
consider it favorably!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Please, I'm counting on you...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Tarumae! Are you on your way back from 
the zoo?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, how was your trip to the lucky 
direction? Did your fortune go up?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ……Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It went up! In truth, it was just good 
luck, though... Looking solely at the 
results, you were right...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Right, right? See? My feng shui really is 
amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I-It's only been one time. There's a much 
higher chance this was just a fluke...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll read your fortune again! 
If it comes true, you'll finally believe 
me this time, right?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"If you could just be a bit more specific. 
Like exactly what time and where it'll 
happen...!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: That's basically a prophecy at this point.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If you keep it vague, anything can sound 
like a hit, right? I won't believe it 
unless you're specific.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If you keep it vague, anything can sound 
like a hit, right? I won't believe it 
unless you're specific.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Right~...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh come on, please just call it 
logical...!

Continuing their cheerful banter, the 
three of them headed on their way home.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Right? Don't you think so too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~, but feng shui isn't really supposed 
to work like that...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I shall also proceed with 
the same stance as before!

"Neither side gave an inch, and just like 
always, it ended in a draw."
